rows.name: Default file to open
rows.description: Choose which file to open when the app starts.

rows.name: File to open
rows.description: Select a specific file to open by default.

rows.name: Always focus new tabs
rows.description: When you open a link in a new tab, switch to it immediately.

rows.name: Default location for new notes
rows.description: Where newly created notes are placed.

rows.name: Folder to create new notes in
rows.description: Newly created notes will appear in this folder.

rows.name: Default location for new attachments
rows.description: Where newly added attachments are placed.

rows.name: Attachment folder path
rows.description: Place newly created attachment files, such as images created via drag-and-drop or audio recordings, in this folder.

rows.name: Subfolder name
rows.description: If your file is in “vault/folder”, and you set subfolder name to “attachments”, attachments will be saved to “vault/folder/attachments”.

rows.name: New link format
rows.description: What links to insert when auto-generating internal links.

rows.name: Automatically update internal links
rows.description: Turn off to be prompted to update links after renaming a file.

rows.name: Use [[Wikilinks]]
rows.description: Auto-generate Wikilinks for [[links]] and ![[images]] instead of Markdown links and images. Disable this option to generate Markdown links instead.

rows.name: Show all file types
rows.description: Show files with any extension even if Obsidian can't open them natively, so you can link to them and see them in File Explorer and Quick Switcher.

rows.name: Delete attachments when deleting files
rows.description: Automatically remove attachments linked to the deleted file if they're not used elsewhere.

rows.name: Deleted files
rows.description: What happens to a file after you delete it.

rows.name: Excluded files
rows.description: Excluded files will be hidden in Search, Graph View, and Unlinked Mentions, less noticeable in Quick Switcher and link suggestions.

rows.name: Override config folder
rows.description: Use a different config folder than the default one. Must start with a dot.

rows.name: Allow URI callbacks
rows.description: Enable the use of x-callback-url through x-success or x-error when handling Obsidian URIs. Learn more

rows.name: Rebuild vault cache
rows.description: Rebuilding the cache could take a few seconds to a few minutes depending on the size of your vault.Learn more
